attempt.hypothesis: The terminal Campaign 8 ledger should reconcile all candidate, integration, graph, Council, diff, artifact, and full-suite attempts before documentation is sealed.
attempt.scope: Read-only final aggregation of docs/experiments/attempts/C8-*.json before the last workflow and diff records.
attempt.rollback: No rollback required for read-only accounting; retain and report any mismatch.
attempt.decision_rationale: Final campaign totals must disclose every retained failure and measured child-command duration.

command: import collections,json,pathlib; ps=sorted(pathlib.Path('docs/experiments/attempts').glob('C8-*.json')); ds=[json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in ps]; statuses=collections.Counter(d.get('execution',{}).get('status','MISSING') for d in ds); print(json.dumps({'attempts_before_this_record':len(ds),'statuses':dict(statuses),'timeouts':sum(bool(d.get('execution',{}).get('timed_out')) for d in ds),'wall_time_seconds':sum(float(d.get('execution',{}).get('wall_time_seconds') or 0) for d in ds),'record_statuses':dict(collections.Counter(d.get('record_status','MISSING') for d in ds))},sort_keys=True))
